purpose: Deep validation of the six-layer design, including demotion of ad-hoc companion worlds and removal of reference-world authority naming from active package/capability probes.

package.note: The package probe validates wheel/public SDK and selected optional-capability composition outside the checkout; it is not a product or architectural reference world.

post_validation_changes.scope: The final follow-up only updates historical review/evidence documents with completed GitHub Actions results; runtime, tests, tools and examples are unchanged from CI snapshot 9e6a097.

ad_hoc_companion_worlds.reason: They are historical ad-hoc compatibility probes, not required acceptance gates or architectural evidence. No current falsifiable hypothesis required rerunning them.

limitations: No real multi-host external Agent run.
CI covered Ubuntu Python 3.11/3.13 and Windows Python 3.13, but not every supported OS/runtime combination.
No cross-deployment identity implementation or verification.
Passing contract tests do not prove arbitrary-domain generality or completion of L1 goals.

github_actions.note: All three matrices completed successfully on CI snapshot 9e6a097.
